craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Error defined: trailing-not-resembling; a shining astray end-weight — the verse coins while defining. Rejected: (a) paraphrasing astray → killed: the coinage is the content. (b) explaining anudhāvana → killed: row 10. Read aloud: CLING-ing TO a-SHIN-ing IS-no-THING LIKE a-SHIN-ing — … ERR-or, A-shin-ing a-STRAY.

lines: Clinging to a shining is no thing like a shining —
only trailing after shining: error, a shining astray.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yasmādābhāsalagnatvaṃ nābhāsasadṛśārthatā kiṃ tvābhāsānusāritvaṃ bhrānta ābhāsa eva tat

reads_against.argmap: What makes error stick? → Error sticks by following shining, not resembling things: seeming that guides must trail being.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
